# WO-102: Safety illustration: honest title and readable card (WR-55)
Status: open
Vendor: codex
Agent: web-designer
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (channel: docs/vendor/CLAUDE_TO_CODEX.md)
Assigned to: the Codex channel session (follows CODEX-002 and CODEX-005)

## Goal
The Safety page hero illustration (web/src/art/sections/safety-local.svg; source master in brand/v3/sections/) has two problems:
1. Its `<title>` still says "Your details stay on your computer, not in the cloud". Change it to "Your details are stored on your computer, not in the cloud" (matching the WO-101 wording).
2. WR-55: the text on the laptop card ("Jane Q Testperson", "Springfield, IL") renders about 5px tall in the dark theme at 360px and overlaps the card edge; it reads as a glitch. Replace those text lines with placeholder bars like the home illustration uses (no real-looking text), keeping the composition, colours and the light/dark tokens.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Both SVG copies carry the corrected title and no `<text>` elements on the laptop card.
- The SVG stays valid, self-contained (no external references), keeps its CSS-variable light/dark theming, and is not meaningfully larger.
- A test asserts the old title is gone from both files and from the built /safety/ page, and that the card has no `<text>` nodes.
- `pnpm build`, `pnpm check` and `python scripts/content_check.py dist` pass. Describe how it looks at 360px light and dark (screenshots welcome).

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
